explication: EDK II is a cross-platform UEFI/PI firmware development environment. Its principal runtime workflow is platform startup through SEC/PEI initialization, DXE driver publication of hardware protocols, and consumption by firmware applications or an operating-system loader. The sampled implementation emphasizes storage-security flows: PEI consumers use the storage-security abstraction, AHCI/NVMe drivers issue device security commands, while TCG Opal and TPM libraries construct and submit protected-storage operations. Several broader firmware subsystems are visible in the tree, but their internal wiring was not sampled.
